paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（特别是半可分矩阵）建立状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的理论联系 [S1.p2][S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵 [S3.SS3.p2]，并证明标量-恒等结构的 SSM 与 1-半可分结构化掩码注意力互为对偶，同时具有线性与二次两种形式 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于该框架，作者设计了新的 SSD 算法，通过块分解结合线性递推与二次注意力模式，比 Mamba 的优化选择性扫描实现快 2-8 倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S6.p2]。作者进一步设计了 Mamba-2 架构，在语言建模上匹配或超越 Mamba 与开源 Transformer [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化 SSM 与注意力变体之间丰富的理论联系，从而将原本为 Transformer 开发的算法与系统优化迁移到 SSM 上 [S1.p2]。原文指出，SSM 的发展与社区改进 Transformer 的集体努力显得脱节，导致 SSM 比 Transformer 更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度都难以像 Transformer 那样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective.

method.text: 论文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过结构化矩阵（具有次二次参数和乘法复杂度的矩阵）这一抽象来连接结构化 SSM 与注意力变体 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵，从而将 SSM 的高效计算问题归约为结构化矩阵乘法算法 [S3.SS3.p2][S3.SS4.p1]。在此基础上，作者提出基于半可分矩阵块分解的 SSD 算法，对角块用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用秩结构归约为更小的递推 [S6.p4]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
Equation ( 3) directly establishes the link between state space models and the sequentially semiseparable representation
it will allow us to reduce the problem of efficient computation of SSMs (and other sequence models) into efficient algorithms for structured matrix multiplication.
we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode
the off-diagonal blocks can be factored by the rank-structure of semiseparable matrices and reduced to a smaller recurrence.

experiments.text: 作者在合成联想回忆任务（MQAR）上评估 Mamba-2，并在标准语言建模预训练与下游评估中与 Mamba、Transformer++ 及 Pythia 等模型比较 [S9.p1]。语言建模实验使用 Pile 数据集，模型规模从 125M 到 2.7B，遵循 GPT3 规格，其中 2.7B 模型在 Pile 上训练 300B tokens [S9.SS2.p1][A4.SS3.p1]。作者还基准测试了 SSD 算法相对 Mamba 扫描实现和 FlashAttention-2 的速度 [S9.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We empirically evaluate Mamba-2 on synthetic recall tasks that have been challenging for recurrent models
The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
we train Mamba-2 on 300B tokens on the Pile, using the GPT-NeoX tokenizer.
We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2

findings.text: SSD 算法比 Mamba 的融合扫描实现快 2-8 倍，且由于序列长度的线性缩放，从序列长度 2K 起快于 FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。在缩放定律实验中，Mamba-2 在困惑度、理论 FLOPs 和实际墙钟时间上 Pareto 支配 Mamba 与 Transformer++ [S9.F9]。在零样本评估中，每种模型规模下 Mamba-2 均优于 Mamba，并大致匹配两倍模型规模的 Pythia [S9.T1]。在 MQAR 任务上，Mamba-1 表现挣扎而 Mamba-2 在所有设置下表现良好，且增大状态规模持续提升性能 [S9.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: it is 2-8 $\times$ faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan
SSD is faster than FlashAttention-2 starting at sequence length $2K$.
Mamba-2 is Pareto dominant on performance (perplexity), theoretical FLOPs, and actual wall-clock time.
For each model size, Mamba-2 outperforms Mamba, and generally matches Pythia at twice the model size.
While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
increasing from $\mathtt{N}=16$ to $\mathtt{N}=64$ and $\mathtt{N}=256$ consistently improves performance on MQAR

limitations.text: 作者指出，相比此前的结构化 SSM，SSD 的主要限制在于状态转移 $A_t$ 的表达能力，SSD 仅使用比 Mamba 稍更受限的对角 $A_t$ 形式，以表达能力换取硬件效率与实现便利 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者还指出，Mamba-2 整体在短序列长度（如 2K）下训练效率可能不如 Transformer，因为相同参数量下 Mamba-2 有 L 个 SSD 层而 Transformer 有 L/2 个 MLP 层和 L/2 个注意力层 [S9.SS3.p2]。此外，作者强调 SSD 并不泛化标准 softmax 注意力或任何没有有限特征映射的注意力核变换 [S10.SS3.p8]。

evidence.quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions $A_{t}$.
SSD differs only in a slightly more restrictive form of diagonal $A_{t}$, and trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency
the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length (e.g. at $2K$)
SSD does not generalize standard softmax attention, or any other transformation on the attention kernel matrix that does not have a finite feature map $\psi$.
